blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all 11 current renders: the shorts still read as blunt thigh panels; sit and crouch expose gray avatar surfaces through and around the garment, with coverage breaks at both flexed thighs. The bounded Neutral-surface projection did not verify coverage. Redesign a connected seat/gusset and thigh wrap; no fit acceptance.

Direct inspection of current front, side, rear, sit and crouch renders: standing folds remain weak and the rear/side hem has abrupt angular steps; sitting and crouching collapse the overskirt into broad folded sheets behind and between the legs. Correct pattern contour and cloth response; no appearance acceptance.

Direct inspection of current front, side, arms-up and arm-cross renders: shoulder and sleeve-cap joins remain lumpy, sleeve surfaces show heavy faceting/wrinkles, and underarm deformation remains uneven. Correct panel joins and surface flow before appearance acceptance.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
